identification_boundary: A price/index movement can externally corroborate market stress, but it cannot by itself identify waiting, rerouting, cancellation, trapped loaded DWT, or insurance-excluded DWT. No registry entry recalibrates scenario behavior coefficients.

sources.source_name: LMA/IUA Joint War Committee Listed Areas JWLA-033
sources.reason: Public war-risk area designation. Application to an individual insurance contract remains subject to negotiation and it is not a quoted premium series.
Public global premium and loss-ratio aggregates by insurance line; not route-level war-risk pricing or bindability.
Official safety notices can identify affected areas, but public official data do not publish vessel-level quoted war-risk premiums or bindability.
